gap_text: The skfolio receipt covers a selected ETF sample (SPY, QQQ, IWM), not a point-in-time equity universe. Labels are raw-price, not total-return, and each candidate has only 11 complete reserved episodes. It records no alpha, P&L, fill, dividend or cash reconciliation, and no new LEAN or Nautilus engine execution.

preregistration.written_at_note: Upper bound: the commit time of the first preregistration commit (4484138). Written between 06:18:35Z and that commit; corrected in the same unpushed commit before any check ran.
preregistration.expectation: The frozen selections (each development fold's chosen candidate applied to its evaluation episodes, and the reserved-2021Q1 momentum20 selection) execute in a NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 BacktestEngine with fills at session opens, a 10 bp/side taker fee, and every cash transition reconciling exactly. Raw-price per-episode price ratios equal evaluate.py gross_price_label. Dividends are handled in two arms: RAW bars with dividends computed independently from LEAN factor files (not credited in engine cash), and ADJ bars (raw price times LEAN price factor, dividend-inclusive).
criteria: Every scheduled order fills once at the arm's session open price; independent fill audit passes for every fill (side, qty, price, commission).
Every account-report cash transition equals independent Decimal arithmetic; final open orders and positions are zero.
RAW arm: fill price ratio exit_open/entry_open per episode equals evaluate.py gross_price_label + 1 for the traded asset (exact Decimal).
Strategy-internal momentum decision recomputed from the close ticks it receives equals the frozen schedule's weights at every decision.

Dividend amounts reported per ex-date held; ADJ minus RAW ending equity is compared to credited-equivalent dividend income as a consistency check (sign and order of magnitude, not exact, because ADJ reinvests).

Outcome ceiling: advanced. PIT universe, total-return labels inside evaluate.py, episode count, alpha and in-engine dividend cash crediting (peer-owned dividend SimulationModule) remain outside this check.

fix_rounds.label: fix round 1 (gaps 0 and 10), written after round-1 Nautilus output was seen
fix_rounds.trigger: Round 1: RAW arms reconciled exactly; both ADJ arms failed the cash-sequence audit ('cash sequence mismatch', 'final cash 89651.82 != independent 89651.9250'; reserved '100814.92 != 100814.9167') and the realized-PnL identity. ADJ prices have 4 decimals, so qty*price has sub-cent notional; the independent arithmetic did not round it.
fix_rounds.diagnosis: Testing five rounding rules against round-1 development-ADJ reports: per-fill notional rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_EVEN matched all 276 cash transitions (HALF_UP 163, DOWN/FLOOR 5, CEILING 6). Per-position realized PnL matched round_half_even(qty*(exit-entry)) - fees in 136/138 positions; the 2 others differ by 0.01 at exact half-cent ties (consistent with binary floating-point rounding).
fix_rounds.change: Audit v2 rounds each fill notional to cents with ROUND_HALF_EVEN before the cash update (declared engine currency-precision convention, fitted on development-ADJ round 1; the reserved-ADJ arm's 20 fills act as a check that was not used for fitting). Realized PnL is checked per position with tolerance 0.01 USD; the sum residual against the cash delta is reported, not asserted. Strategy, schedule, prices and engine configuration are unchanged; round-1 outputs are retained.
criteria: All four arms: every cash transition equals independent arithmetic under the declared rule.
Per-position realized PnL within 0.01 USD of independent value; report count of exact matches and total residual.

detection_method: The audit compares every fill, commission and account-report cash total against independent Decimal arithmetic and fails on any difference. It demonstrably fires: round 1 flagged the ADJ sub-cent notional rounding. RAW parity compares Decimal fill-price ratios to evaluate.label exactly; the strategy recomputes momentum from its own ticks and is compared to the frozen weights.
remaining: Selected ETF sample, not a point-in-time universe; evaluate.py labels remain raw-price (total-return labels were not added to evaluate.py); 11 reserved episodes; no alpha claim. The engine does not credit dividend cash: RAW dividends are computed outside the engine and ADJ embeds them in back-adjusted prices that were not tradable historically. In-engine dividend crediting belongs to the peer-owned dividend SimulationModule (sota-workflow-resolution).
limits: Fills are at the session open trade tick with no spread, queue or impact; the synthetic tick size is the whole session volume.
The Nautilus CASH account and 10 bp per side fee are declared conventions, not a broker fee schedule.
Dividend amounts come from LEAN factor files (ref_close * (1 - pf_D/pf_next)), not from an independent corporate-action source.
The ADJ half-even notional rounding rule was fitted on round-1 development-ADJ output; the reserved-ADJ arm (20 fills) was not used for fitting.
